paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thil tengteng na ma ua ka omsak, vualzawlna leh hamsiate na tung ua ahong tun a, TOUPA'N hon delhzakna nam tengteng lak a na theihkhiak nawn ua,
heading: Tunding Nawnna Leh Vualzawlna Lampite
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian lam na ngat nawn ua, tua thu ka hon piak bang a nou leh na tate uh toh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-aw na zuih hun chiang un.
english: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na sal hihna uh ahihmang dia, ahon hehpih dia, TOUPA na Pathian un nam chih lak a hon dalhsakna a pan hon pikhawm nawn ding hi.
heading: Israel Tunung Vualzawlna Dingte
english: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

paite: Na lak ua mi van nuai tawp pha a delhkhiak a-om uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan hon pikhawm dia, huai a pan hon pikhe ding hi.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute un aluah gam ah hon pilut nawn dia, na luah ding uh. Ama'n hon lamzangsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh khup in hon pungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

paite: Na hintheihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na it theihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un na lungtang uh leh na suante lungtang hon sumsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hiai hamsia tengteng hon simmohte, na melmate uh leh hon hote túng ah atungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

paite: Na hong kihei nawn ding ua, ToUPA aw na zui ding uà, tuni a thu ka hon piak, athupiak tengteng na zui ding uhi.
english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna tengteng uah, na gil ua gah ah, na ganhon gah uah leh na gam gah uah hoih atungsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh tung a akipah bang in na tung uah TOUPA akipak nawn ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

paite: Hiai Dan Bu a tuang athupiakte, adante zui dia TOUPA aw na zuih ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na ngat phot uleh.
english: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: Hiai thupiak, tua ka hon piak nou a ding in ahaksa lo kei a, gamlat leng hon gamlat kei hi.
heading: Pathian Thu In Hon Naihna
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

paite: I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in, "Kua ahia van a hon kahsak a, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in van a om ahi kei hi.
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

paite: I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in tuipi gal ah, "Kua'n ahia hon va hohsak dia, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in tuipi gal a om leng ahi sam kei.
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

paite: Na zuihtheihna ding un thu in ahon naih mahmah a, na kam uh leh na lungtang uah a-om hi.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

paite: "Tu in na ma uah hinna leh hoih, sihna leh hoih lou ka koih hi.
heading: Pathian Tel Dia Vauhilhna Nanung
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding, alampi zui ding, athupiak, adan, avaihawm, zui dia tua ka hon thupiak na zuih uleh na hing ding ua, na hong pung ding ua, na va luah ding uh gam ah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uh akiheimang a, na ngaihkhiak kei ua, pimang a na om ua, pathian dangte na biak ua, a-nna uh na sep uleh;
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

paite: na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tu in ka hon hilh ahi. Jordan lui kan a, luah ding a na va lutna gam uah na damsawt kei ding uhi.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

paite: Na ma uah hinna leh sihna, vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih chih tu a hon theihpih ding in lei leh van ka sam ahi. Huchi in hinna tel un, na hinna ding un nou leh na suante uh toh.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it in, a-aw zui in, amah len tinten un, amah na hinna uh, na damsawtna uh lah ahi ngal a. Huchi in na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a piak gam ah na teng ding uhi," achi hi.
english: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
